## Post · 1/8 — QCXINT (@QCXINT_)

🚨 Google is quietly giving developers production-grade Gemini models—for free. 🤯

No credit card.

No trial.

Just generate an API key and start building.

Google's Gemini API Free Tier lets you access the same production-ready models used in real applications, making it one of the best ways to prototype AI projects without paying upfront.

🚀 Free Models

⚡ Gemini 2.5 Flash — Fast, app-ready inference.

🧠 Gemini 2.5 Pro — Advanced reasoning with a free quota.

✨ Gemini 3.6 Flash — Google's latest Flash model, also available on the free tier.

💡 Why it matters

✅ No billing account required.

✅ Permanent free tier (subject to usage limits).

✅ Build AI agents, chatbots, RAG systems, and automation workflows without hitting a paywall on day one.

The free tier includes project-based quotas (RPM, TPM, and RPD), which are more than enough for personal projects, prototypes, and many small applications.

If you eventually need to run everything locally instead of using cloud APIs...

🖥️ Open Source Alternative: Ollama

Ollama lets you run open-source LLMs directly on your own machine.

It supports popular models like Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, MiniMax, DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemma, gpt-oss, and many more.

🔥 Ollama Features

🏠 Run AI models locally with no cloud dependency.

⚡ OpenAI-compatible REST API.

🐳 Docker support.

💻 Native Python & JavaScript SDKs.

🤖 Launch integrations for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, OpenClaw, and more.

📚 Massive ecosystem with hundreds of community integrations for RAG, agents, IDEs, desktop apps, messaging bots, observability, and deployment platforms.

With 177K+ GitHub stars, Ollama has become the default local LLM runtime for developers building privacy-first AI applications.

📖 Gemini API Docs: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits

💰 Gemini Pricing: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing

🔗 Ollama: https://github.com/ollama/ollama

🔗 LiteLLM: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm
